one_line: The subject rises; hair and clothes know it.

prompt_module.template: Locked-off static shot, the framing never changes and the {subject} stays the same size in frame. The {subject} with glowing golden eyes and glowing circuit-lit forearms slowly lifts off the ground and floats straight upward, feet leaving the {ground}, {hair_or_hood} and loose clothing drifting upward as if weightless, eyes and forearms stay brightly lit the whole time, {particles}face and eyes stay sharp and unchanged, clothing print stays identical and only on the shirt, cinematic, photoreal, smooth motion

intensity_map.0.3: barely lifts, toes still brushing the ground
intensity_map.0.6: lifts a full body-height, slow and steady
intensity_map.0.9: rises fast and high, clothing whipping upward, camera tilting hard

prompt_module.negative: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly, static subject, frozen, still image, camera zoom, dolly, push in, pull out, close-up, cropped head, subject leaving the frame, blurry face, changing face, melting, warped text, dark eyes, glow fading, tripod, camera equipment, pattern spreading to pants

camera.note: camera motion words make LTX-2.5 reframe and lose identity; keep static for Levitate

framing_rule: If the subject's bbox height exceeds 70% of the frame (tight crop), cap intensity at 0.4 so the rise stays inside the frame; the camera-tracking line does the rest.
input_requirements: full body visible, feet in frame
9:16 or 16:9; square only if full body fits
